items.headline: Estonia shuts road border with Russia after drone-maker attack
items.summary: Tallinn closed its road crossings after an attack on a drone manufacturer; Moscow complained of a 'new Iron Curtain'.

items.headline: Kushner says Trump open to NATO-style guarantees for Ukraine
items.summary: The US envoy spoke after a Coalition of the Willing summit in Berlin attended by Zelenskiy, Merz, Macron and UK PM Andy Burnham.

items.headline: COP31 climate talks go into overtime over fossil fuels
items.summary: Deadlock over fossil fuel wording pushed the UN summit in Antalya, Turkey, past its scheduled close.

items.headline: FTSE 100 suffers worst week for months, down 5.1%
items.summary: The index fell 1% on Friday to 10,346.34 as the global tech sell-off deepened, despite strong UK retail sales.

items.headline: UK retail sales unexpectedly rise 0.7% in October
items.summary: Sales were lifted by government advice to stock up on long-life items, plus stronger clothing sales; annual growth reached 2.3%.

items.headline: Nvidia plunges 11% as Wall Street sell-off deepens
items.summary: The Nasdaq 100 fell 4.5% as investors kept pulling back from AI-related shares.

items.headline: Anthropic completes $93.5bn share sale as stock slides again
items.summary: Underwriters took up their full option, while the shares fell for a second day. Riot Platforms confirmed a $28bn, 15-year Texas data centre lease with Anthropic.

items.headline: AWS lets AI agents buy software on their own
items.summary: Amazon's marketplace now allows AI agents to purchase software autonomously, Fortune reports.

items.headline: AI-assisted cyberattack disrupts European Commission systems
items.summary: The attack temporarily hit staff payroll and medical reimbursement systems; investigators are checking whether personal data was exposed.
